entries.description: RESEARCH, no-edge (#1669) — Camarilla pivot reversal: the previous complete UTC day (00:00 to 24:00) gives high H, low L and final close C, frozen for the current UTC day as S3 = C - 1.1 x (H - L) / 4, R3 = C + 1.1 x (H - L) / 4, S4 = C - 1.1 x (H - L) / 2 and R4 = C + 1.1 x (H - L) / 2. entries.description: RESEARCH, no-edge (#1668) — Elder Force Index pullback: raw force is the close minus the previous close, multiplied by the candle volume (volume_weighting 1) or by one (volume_weighting 0, the ablation). The smoothed force at every bar is one exponential recursion with weight 2 / (force_period + 1) over exactly recursion_length raw-force values ending at that bar, seeded with the oldest of them, so each value reads only the trailing recursion_length + 1 closes. Uptrend: close strictly above the trend_period close SMA and that SMA strictly above its value slope_span bars earlier; downtrend reverses both. Long when the smoothed force crosses strictly from below zero on the preceding candle to above zero on the current candle while the uptrend holds on both candles; short is the mirror in a downtrend. Exact zero never triggers, and both crossing candles need positive supplied volume in both variants. recursion_length must be at least 10 x force_period and at most 197, and a decision needs max(recursion_length + 2, trend_period + slope_span + 1) clean rows (at most 199) with declared bar cadence; bad candles, timestamp defects, cadence gaps and derived overflow hold with a reason. A newer rise replaces an older bulge. bulge_filter 0 is the comparison mode that tests the same confirmation on every bar with the side from the current slope. entries.description: RESEARCH, no-edge (#1657) — On Balance Volume divergence: signed volume is +volume after a higher close, -volume after a lower close and 0 after an equal close; a strict price pivot (left_span/right_span) is usable only once its right-side bars close; each newly confirmed low pairs with the nearest earlier confirmed low min_separation..max_separation bars back, and a strictly lower low whose signed-volume sum over the pair interval, divided by the absolute-volume sum over the same interval, exceeds volume_threshold arms a long; the mirror high arms a short. entries.description: RESEARCH, production-refused, frozen study FAIL (#1635: on 59 days of the public Hyperliquid l2Book archive every one of 972 variants lost money after costs on train and held-out, the selected variant lost 1000.33 on 5271 held-out positions against 418.67 for donchian_breakout, and the bootstrap lower bound of the improvement was -1105.59) — order-book imbalance on supplied Hyperliquid l2Book snapshots (l2_book_observations, the Delivery 1 l2_book contract): for the first depth_levels levels per side, B = sum(bid px x sz), A = sum(ask px x sz), I = (B - A) / (B + A) and spread_bps = 10000 x (ask - bid) / mid, all in exact rational arithmetic. A book qualifies long when I > entry_threshold and short when I < -entry_threshold (strict; equality is neutral) with spread_bps <= max_spread_bps and B + A >= min_combined_depth_usd. An episode is a same-direction run of distinct qualifying books after a retained boundary (a reset marker, a non-qualifying book or the last book of the opposite run) inside the 60000 ms evidence window; the confirmation_observations-th book is the crossing, and its sole decision deadline is the next UTC whole second at or above max(event, receipt). The entry fires only at that deadline, only if the run is still active and the crossing book's event and receipt are each at most max_snapshot_age_ms old; later deadlines return consumed, a missing boundary returns evidence_truncated, and missing or malformed books hold with a reason. Entry-only; the closed-bar branch is unsupported; research use only: paper evaluation needs exactly one explicit --mode=paper on the Hyperliquid perps shared or websocket feed route, and live use is refused with or without allow_no_edge until a separate reviewed promotion

entries.description: RESEARCH, production-refused, frozen study INCONCLUSIVE (#1639: 9 held-out event-replay positions in a 10.8 h recording, under the 30-position floor; net negative on both windows) — perpetual premium mean reversion on closed bars: premium is the executable bid/ask midpoint divided by the time-aligned oracle price minus one, from supplied synchronized Hyperliquid quote/oracle samples on a fixed 60 s grid (premium_observations; each sample holds the latest bbo and asset context received at or before its grid time). Long when the previous close was at or below its own frozen lower band and the current close is strictly above the current lower band and at or below the current upper band; short mirrors at the upper band. Entries also need the normalized slope (absolute fitted change over the window divided by the window mean) at or below slope_ceiling and the residual deviation at or above min_residual_std (quote-price units). Needs fit_window+2 rows with declared bar cadence; bad prices, timestamp defects, cadence gaps and degenerate fits hold with a reason code. entries.description: RESEARCH, no-edge (#1663) — Stochastic Momentum Index pullback entries: for each bar the highest high and lowest low of the range_period bars ending there give the range (difference) and the relative value (close minus their midpoint). For every endpoint t all five recursions restart at bar t - recursion_length: the relative value and the range are each smoothed twice by an exponential average of smoothing_period (weight 2 / (period + 1)), both stages seeded with that bar's own relative value or range; the oscillator is 200 x smoothed relative / smoothed range, and its signal line is an exponential average of signal_period seeded with the seed-bar oscillator; exactly recursion_length updates run through t. Endpoint t - 1 is replayed independently from its own seed. Needs recursion_length + range_period + 1 valid consecutive closed bars (recursion_length at least 8 x the larger smoothing or signal period, recursion_length + range_period at most 198) and declared bar cadence; any bad candle, timestamp defect, cadence gap or non-positive smoothed range holds, and a check-time frame whose last bar is not the latest closed bar holds. entries.description: RESEARCH, production-refused, frozen study INCONCLUSIVE (#2010: the complete trade-flow recording, required datasets and coverage gates are missing) — liquidity sweep with order-flow absorption and an inverse fair value gap retest on closed candles. The half-open UTC session [session_start_hour_utc, session_end_hour_utc) (a cross-midnight session belongs to its start date) fixes its low and high once its last bar closes. Long: within sweep_window bars after the session end, the first bar whose low is below the session low by at least sweep_atr_mult x the bar's closed simple 14-bar ATR starts the sweep; it must close back above the session low within max_sweep_bars bars (lowest low = sweep wick). The most recent bearish three-bar fair value gap whose third bar closes in the gap_window bars before the sweep start, at least min_fvg_atr x ATR wide, is the zone. Session-anchored signed aggressor volume (supplied Hyperliquid trade_flow_observations, every minute complete, unrevoked and summing to the candle volume by the decision deadline) must keep its minimum over the sweep bars strictly above the delta at the session-low bar, with the change divided by the observed volume between them above absorption_threshold (absorption_filter=false is the price-only control with identical data eligibility). The first close above the gap top within confirm_window bars after the reclaim must have a bullish body of at least min_displacement_atr x ATR and a confirmed one-hour higher-low swing structure (strict 2/2 pivots in the last 24 hours, from supplied htf_candles); it arms the setup. A later bar within setup_expiry bars that reaches the entry_level of the zone (0.5 = consequent encroachment) enters once; a close below the wick, a bar wholly below the zone, revoked flow, expiry or the next session clears it. Shorts mirror every rule. Missing flow, higher-timeframe candles or decision timing hold the entry with a reason. Entry-only; research use only: paper evaluation needs exactly one explicit --mode=paper on the Hyperliquid perps shared or websocket feed route with closed_bar_decisions, and live use is refused with or without allow_no_edge until a separate reviewed promotion

entries.description: RESEARCH, no-edge (#1667) — True Strength Index (TSI) trend entries: for every endpoint the evaluator reads exactly recursion_length closes and their recursion_length - 1 successive changes; the signed changes and their absolute values are each smoothed by a slow EMA (weight 2 / (slow_period + 1)) and then a fast EMA (weight 2 / (fast_period + 1)), both stages seeded from the first change of that window. TSI is 100 times the double-smoothed signed change divided by the double-smoothed absolute change; the signal line is an EMA (weight 2 / (signal_period + 1)) of TSI, unset until the first finite TSI of the window and seeded with it. The previous endpoint uses its own window, so a decision reads recursion_length + 1 bars (at most 199). Long when TSI minus signal line is strictly positive, was at or below zero on the previous bar, and TSI is strictly positive; short is the exact mirror. Needs declared bar cadence and recursion_length >= 6 * slow_period; bad candles, timestamp defects, cadence gaps, a zero denominator and invalid derived values inside the window hold. Both decision deadlines must see the same complete, unrevoked profile; boundary touches, opposite-boundary overshoots, the first candle of a session, gaps and a missing, pending, revoked or malformed profile hold the entry with a reason. session_bounds=true is the ablation that uses the session low and high instead of the value area.
